raw_response: {"diagnosis": "85 EUR-denominated transactions are summed as if they were USD, because silver_transactions ignores the currency column. raw_fx_rates holds a USD conversion rate for each currency (EUR = 1.25, one row per currency), so silver amounts should be converted to USD before the gold aggregates are built.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(round(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON t.currency = f.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
